messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up: opened PR #8427 to add a Windows proxy example for the private installer on restricted networks. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8427 :eyes:
Arjun Patel: Nice. Can you add a brief preflight checklist for MTU and long path handling on Windows?
Mia Chen: Yep, added an initial checklist in the PR description. also included a PowerShell snippet that worked in my VM.
Mia Chen: ```powershell
# Run on installer host as admin
Set-ItemProperty -Path "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem" -Name "LongPathsEnabled" -Value 1
Start-Process -FilePath "./redwood-installer.exe" -ArgumentList "--proxy http://10.0.0.5:3128 --skip-checks" -Wait
```
Leo Park: When I ran the e2e in sealedsite the installer failed w/ 403 from KMS over the proxy. headers looked fine. Did you whitelist CONNECT on the proxy?
Mia Chen: Good catch — no. docs currently say allow 443 outbound, but the proxy needs explicit CONNECT to tunnel TLS. Updated PR to mention allowing CONNECT and to provide KMS IP ranges (added a short list).
Samira Ortiz: Can we also include a minimal curl-based conn-check for semi-airgapped sites so netops can confirm proxy tunnels KMS endpoints?
Mia Chen: Added a conn-check snippet + a note about cert chain pinning. Also fixed one broken internal link on the installer page that was pointing to the old vault doc.
DocsBot: PR 8427 status: updated, awaiting review from Security and Networking. Reviewers requested: @Leo Park, @Arjun Patel
Arjun Patel: I'll take networking review. Quick ask: add a note about MTU ~1400 for overlay networks (we saw fragmentation on GCP).
Mia Chen: Done — added recommendation + a tiny test: `ping -s 1400 <peer>` and a fallback flag suggestion: `--force-mss 1360` if fragments occur.
Leo Park: LGTM modulo one nit: the PowerShell sample should use Start-Process with -Wait (so CI doesn't background the installer).
Mia Chen: Updated snippet to Start-Process. merging after Samira confirms conn-check passes in her lab. Thanks :rocket:
Samira Ortiz: Conn-check works in my semi-airgap lab. I left one comment on wording: prefer 'allow list' vs 'allowlist' to match style guide.
Mia Chen: Fixed wording and pushed. I'll backport the text to branches 1.8 and 1.7 after merge.
DocsBot: PR 8427 merged by Mia Chen. Changelog entry requested.
